# ThinkTools

> Publisher of practical engineering calculation engines, Excel construction toolkits, and custom software solutions for Indian builders, civil engineers, contractors, and creators.

ThinkTools simplifies complex civil engineering mathematics and project management into instant-calculation workbooks aligned with Indian Standards (IS 456, IS 1200, CPWD). All software products are delivered digitally with 100% offline lifetime ownership and zero recurring SaaS subscriptions.

## Products & Toolkits

- [Construction Calculator Pro (31 Sheets)](https://thinktools.in/p/construction-calculator-pro): Flagship Excel toolkit covering complete material quantity estimation (cement, sand, aggregate, steel, bricks, paint, tiles, electrical, plumbing), BOQ costing, rate analysis, and anti-fear contractor audit checklists. ₹299 base / ₹499 VIP bundle.
- [Site Expense & Profit Tracker](https://thinktools.in/p/construction-calculator-pro): Comprehensive cashflow, contractor advances, and site profitability tracking system.
- [Labour Attendance & Weekly Wage Sheet](https://thinktools.in/p/construction-calculator-pro): Automated muster roll, overtime calculation, advance deductions, and weekly wage slips.
- [Payment Collection Tracker](https://thinktools.in/p/construction-calculator-pro): Invoice aging tracker with automated payment follow-up schedules and WhatsApp reminder templates.
